away.summary: The Wild (17-3-5) are riding a nine-game road win streak and have allowed two or fewer goals in each win. They will be without star defenseman Quinn Hughes, who returned to Minnesota for evaluation after an undisclosed injury, and Olli Maatta (upper body). Filip Gustavsson will make his season debut after missing the start of the season with a lower-body injury.

home.summary: The Sharks (11-12-2) are coming off a 4-3 win against the Seattle Kraken. Darnell Kesselring returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch, while Collin Graf and Libor Hajek are scratched. The Sharks are dealing with injuries to Igor Chernyshov, Kiefer Sherwood, and Jacob Trouba.
